title: rosa alpina var. rubella
intro: Rosa alpina var. rubella, commonly known as Alpine Rose, is a fragrant, pink-colored variety of the Rosa alpina species, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of Rosa alpina var. rubella include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Rosa alpina var. rubella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
